title: Nova Scotia Class 7 Learner's Licence Knowledge Test
note: Every value below is taken from the official Class 7 knowledge test page. Nothing here is hard-coded in application components; the UI and the mock-test engine read this file.

sections.name: Rules of the Road Test
sections.description: Assesses your knowledge of the traffic laws and rules for safe driving.

sections.name: Road Sign Recognition Test
sections.description: Assesses your ability to recognize and understand the meaning of highway road signs.

retakeRules.note: If you fail both parts you retake both parts. A new test fee applies to each attempt.

otherRequirements: Provide identification showing legal name and date of birth
No outstanding fines or privilege reinstatement fees
Licence not suspended and not otherwise prohibited from holding one

onlineRequirements: Desktop computer or laptop (not a phone or tablet)

preparation.officialInstruction: Review the Driver's Handbook to prepare for the Knowledge Test.

afterPassing: You do not receive the licence immediately and cannot drive right away
Visit Registry of Motor Vehicles or Access Nova Scotia to complete the remaining requirements
Pay the Learner's Licence fee and have your photo taken
